answer: Each identity anchors a voyage chain on a ridge registry: lock a 70-credit bond, file one signed voyage leg each epoch, each leg chained to the last. A spiral audit rewinds the chain, checking order, key, time; a missed, late, or rented leg breaks it, burning the bond. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fake voyage chains pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. A rented key cannot sign the next leg. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
